lane: two-view co-training (Blum & Mitchell 1998, doi:10.1145/279943.279962); View A potential-field and subsurface (geodetic strain bands 4/7/8 + isostatic gravity bands 13/18 cross-family control), View B surface (detrended elevation band 12, its slope band 19, aeroradiometric total count band 6); disagreement as the discovery signal; primary arm is the A-confident/B-abstains buried-fault quadrant
mechanism: odd-symmetric (signed dipole) fault-normal profile decomposition: odd=(B(+h)-B(-h))/2, even=(B(+h)+B(-h))/2 at h in {1,2} px along a visible-catalogue-measured fault normal quantised to 8 compass directions; discriminator is odd-dominance odd^2/(|odd|+|even|+eps) and the sign-reversal couple min(|B+|,|B-|)*1[sign differs]
named_non_fault_mimic: geodetic strain is a smooth interpolation of sparse GPS/InSAR observations: (i) station-density gradients and block-boundary smoothing seams create signed couples with no structure; (ii) magmatic inflation/deflation is dilatant by definition; (iii) post-seismic viscoelastic relaxation after the 1954 Fairview Peak and 1959 Hebgen Lake sequences; (iv) elastic strain on an already-mapped fault, removed by the 200 m catalogue ring
shared_tools_to_reuse: src/gems52/metric.py (literal published DTI transcription, pinned by tests/test_metric.py)
promotion_rule: promote only if the primary's paired 95% CI lower bound against single_B is above zero on gems52-pooled-hide-v1; otherwise NEGATIVE, research-only artefact, DOWNLOAD yes / SUBMIT no, 0 weekly slots spent

experiments: E1 channels + leakage canary + per-fold fit + OOF AUC
E2 independence screen + nine-budget matched hide-and-recover holdout
E3 build + lane/uniqueness gates + GeoTIFF + run card + site publication
